description: Configure a safe environment switching system for a backend API service with three environments (development, staging, production). Create VSCode tasks in .vscode/tasks.json with three tasks: one for switching to development, one for staging, and one for production. Create a switching script at scripts/switch-env.sh (Bash) or scripts/switch_env.py (Python) that accepts environment name as argument, copies the corresponding .env.{environment} file to .env, and requires explicit confirmation (like typing 'CONFIRM PRODUCTION') before switching to production. Configure .vscode/settings.json to add visual indicators: status bar background color (statusBar.background or workbench.colorCustomizations) and window title (window.title) showing the current environment. Optionally add extension recommendations in .vscode/extensions.json for dotenv support. The goal is to prevent accidental operations against production by making the current environment visually obvious and requiring confirmation for dangerous operations.
